---
title: "Probability approach (Output 6)"
guide-section: "User Guide"
---

Output 6 compares baseline, historical, and most-extreme stress paths and
calculates distress probabilities from the workbook covariates. Edit the
probability inputs together with Macro, Ext, Input 6/7, and CI Summary.

> Excel → baseline + historical + most-extreme path + covariates → Output 6

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.run import SHEET_6, compute_outputs

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
output = compute_outputs(workbook, include=[SHEET_6])
probability = output.sheets[SHEET_6]
```

The exported `SHEET_6` panel currently assembles the PV-of-external-debt-to-GDP
probability view. It uses:

- the baseline external debt path;
- the A1 historical scenario;
- the most-extreme standard stress path;
- the applicable CI threshold and borderline band;
- covariates loaded by `load_probability`.

For indicator-by-indicator work, use `probability_panel` with
`ProbabilityAssumptions` and the result of `load_probability`. The paired
notebook builds and displays the debt-scenario and probability tables for all
four external indicators; those additional views are not separate sheets in
`compute_outputs`.

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| Distress-regression covariates | Probability approach / imported data |
| Historical path | A1 historical |
| Most-extreme path | Chart Data |
| Scenario levels and probabilities | Output 6 |

Customized scenario A2 is a tailored stress input and belongs in the
[Stress DSA](03-stress-dsa.qmd) workflow; it is not the probability engine.

The complete worked example is
[`demo/output_6.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_6.ipynb).
